name: brave-skill
description: Brave Skill Skill Acquisition Academy — learning platform by Emyphill-Tech Global Solutions Limited

scripts.db:push: npm run db:d1:generate && npm run db:d1:apply
scripts.db:migrate: echo 'Create a numbered SQL migration from the Prisma schema and apply it with Wrangler D1. See docs/CLOUDFLARE.md.'
scripts.db:studio: echo 'Prisma Studio is not supported for the remote D1 adapter. Use Cloudflare D1 dashboard or wrangler d1 execute.'
scripts.db:reset: echo 'D1 does not support prisma migrate reset. For a new database, create a fresh D1 database and run npm run db:d1:generate.'
scripts.setup: npm run db:d1:generate && npm run db:d1:apply && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:d1:generate: mkdir -p migrations && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > migrations/0001_initial.sql
scripts.db:d1:apply: if wrangler d1 execute brave-skill-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='User';" | grep -q 'User'; then echo 'D1 schema already exists; create a numbered migration for changes.'; else wrangler d1 execute brave-skill-db --remote --file=migrations/0001_initial.sql; fi
